narration.text: If he'd gone quiet there's one place it shows up first. New records either chart or they don't. Seventeen years since So Far Gone. Pick the year the ticks stop lighting.
narration.measuredTranscript: If he'd gone quiet, there's one place it shows up first. New records either chart or they don't. 17 years since so far gone. Pick the year the ticks stop lighting.

acceptableDurationSeconds.note: Descriptive. Corpus median 9.0s, p75 14.0s. Never a cap: the evidence sets the length.

internalChangeBudget.note: Advisory. May suggest splitting a unit, but never rejects a candidate and never forces a split. Overridden whenever the content needs the time.

contract.takeaway: Almost everyone present at the start is gone seventeen years later, and he is not.

claims.text: Seventeen years have passed since So Far Gone.
Chart presence is the test: new records either chart or they do not.
The 2009 cohort thins to a small number of survivors by 2026.
sourceCandidates: per-artist chart-entry years for the verified starting cohort

requiredMedia.contentRequirement: Verified starting cohort with a chart-entry year per artist, so each exit fires in the first year that artist fails the stated test.
Approved headshot cutouts for the cohort. Spatial rules require headshot through one-quarter-body crop only.
A persistent readable year callout advancing one calendar year at a time.

visualEvents.triggerPhrase: New records either chart or they don't
visualEvents.description: The test is stated and the full starting field is visible.
visualEvents.matchedTranscript: New records either chart or they don't.

visualEvents.triggerPhrase: Seventeen years since So Far Gone
visualEvents.description: The year anchor establishes 2009 as the start.

visualEvents.triggerPhrase: Pick the year the ticks stop lighting
visualEvents.description: The attrition runs and resolves on the survivors. The complete starting field must have been readable before the first exit.
visualEvents.matchedTranscript: Pick the year the ticks stop lighting.

prohibitions.prohibition: Do not begin the survivor framing before the last non-survivor exit is readable.
prohibitions.reason: Spatial rendering rules require the complete active field to stay in frame through the final exit.

prohibitions.prohibition: Do not stagger exits by array position or animation order.
prohibitions.reason: Spatial rendering rules: remove each subject in the first year it fails the stated test.
Only explicitly narrated primary subjects may enlarge.

successConditions: The viewer sees everyone present at the start.
The viewer sees the field thin year by year.
Only verified survivors remain at the end.
failureConditions: The starting field is never fully visible, so the attrition has no baseline.
Exit order does not follow the stated test.

groundTruth.desired: Cohort attrition timeline with the starting field visible and only verified survivors remaining
